messages.text: Any update for this order? Thanks Michael

Hi Michael,

Thanks for checking in, and I'm sorry this has run well past the September date you were given.

Your B30 is in batch 1, and the date your order carries now is November 7. Those units are built and on their way to our Chattanooga warehouse. Once the batch is checked in, the warehouse ships oldest orders first, and yours was placed July 19, so it sits near the front of that queue. You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The free Power Kit we added to your order after the September notice is already reserved at the warehouse and goes out in the same box, at no cost to you.

Your DHL tracking comes to this address automatically as soon as the label is printed. Worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts so it doesn't land in junk.

Thanks again for hanging in there, Michael.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
Thank you, So far I have not received anything, but I will keep looking. Michael

Hi Michael,

Sorry that one did not reach you. Here is the update directly, so you have it in writing.

Your B30 is batch 1 and the date on your order now is November 15. On our side, batch 2 has shipped from the factory and batch 3 left on November 4, with units rolling out to customers through mid November. Your order is from July 19, and the warehouse ships oldest orders first, so you are near the front of the queue once the units are checked in at Chattanooga. You can follow those shipments on their way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The free Power Kit added to your order in September is already reserved at the warehouse and goes out in the same box, at no extra cost.

Your DHL tracking comes to this address the moment the label is printed. Our mail has been landing in junk for some customers, so adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts will keep it visible.

Thanks for your patience on this one, Michael.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
